entries.label: Reporting entity
entries.description: Legal name of the entity preparing the workpaper.

entries.label: Counterparty / customer
entries.description: Legal name of the customer or counterparty to the arrangement.

entries.label: Contract date
entries.description: Execution date of the governing agreement.

entries.label: Stated contract term
entries.description: Term as written, before enforceability analysis.

entries.label: Renewal option
entries.description: Renewal terms: automatic vs. optional, notice period, renewal pricing.

entries.label: Termination provision
entries.description: Termination-for-convenience or for-cause rights, notice periods, penalties.

entries.label: Termination penalty
entries.description: Amount payable on early termination, if any.

entries.label: Payment terms
entries.description: Billing frequency, due dates, milestones.

entries.label: Stated contract fees
entries.description: Total fees as stated on the face of the contract or order form.

entries.label: Discount
entries.description: Discount from list price granted in the arrangement.

entries.label: Modification description
entries.description: What the amendment adds, removes, or reprices.

entries.label: Customer credit profile
entries.description: Credit checks, payment history, or other collectability evidence.

entries.label: Transaction price
entries.description: Total consideration for the contract (fixed consideration; note treatment of variable amounts).

entries.label: Enforceable contract term
entries.description: Enforceable contract term, after analysis of termination provisions.

entries.label: Performance obligation count
entries.description: Number of distinct performance obligations identified.

entries.label: Distinctness conclusion
entries.description: Distinctness conclusion for a questioned promise.

entries.label: Collectability conclusion
entries.description: Step-1 collectability conclusion.

entries.label: Modification treatment
entries.description: Accounting treatment of any contract modification.

entries.label: Variable consideration
entries.description: Estimated variable consideration before the constraint.

entries.label: Variable consideration constraint
entries.description: Whether the constraint limits estimated variable consideration.

entries.label: SSP — subscription element
entries.description: Standalone selling price of the subscription element.

entries.label: SSP — implementation/services element
entries.description: Standalone selling price of the implementation or services element.

entries.label: SSP — other element
entries.description: Standalone selling price of any other identified element.

entries.label: Recognition timing/pattern
entries.description: When (or as) each performance obligation is satisfied.

entries.label: Period revenue
entries.description: Revenue recognized in the covered period.

entries.label: Deferred revenue balance
entries.description: Contract liability balance at period end.

entries.label: Fair value
entries.description: Fair value of the unit of account at the measurement date.

entries.label: Principal market
entries.description: Principal (or most advantageous) market for the asset or liability.

entries.label: Observable input
entries.description: A quoted price or other observable input used in the measurement.

entries.label: Unobservable input
entries.description: A significant unobservable input (Level 3) and its value or range.

entries.label: Delivery / go-live date
entries.description: Date a good was delivered or a service went live.

entries.label: Period covered
entries.description: Reporting period the workpaper covers.

entries.label: Exchange rate
entries.description: FX rate used, with source and date.
